description: Production artifacts for the Unify Financial Health Score. Per-age-band synthetic ideal centroids. Citation state is MIXED, not uniform - per feature: CITED to a named source - emergency_fund_months (MoneySense 6-month fund), investment_rate (MoneySense 10-15%-of-income), life_coverage_ratio (LIA PGS 2022, 9-10x income), ci_coverage_ratio (LIA PGS 2022, ~3.9x income), savings_rate 0.30 (above MoneySense's 20% minimum recommendation, aligned with SingStat's observed ~31-37% national personal savings rate), net_worth_to_income ladder 1/4/8/12/15 (a widely-cited age-based net-worth multiple planning heuristic - ~1x income by 30, rising with age - not an official SG wealth-by-age table, as none is published). REASONED, not cited - dti 0.15 (conservative vs MAS's 55% TDSR regulatory ceiling; no specific 'ideal DTI' benchmark exists, so this is a health target well below the compliance maximum, not a cited figure). UNCITED - portfolio_concentration 0.20 (no SG-specific benchmark exists for portfolio concentration; a reasoned estimate with no citable source). IDEAL BY CONSTRUCTION, for distinct reasons - risk_age_deviation 0.0 is the structural zero-point of a DERIVED quantity (equity_pct minus an age-equity target), i.e. what the subtraction equals when equity allocation exactly matches the target, not a benchmark number at all; hospitalisation_coverage 1.0 is the 'yes' endpoint of a directly-generated binary flag, whose generation probability is anchored to ~71% Integrated Shield Plan prevalence, not a derivation artifact. Locked decisions: K-Means++, k=3, age-stratified (Approach A), RobustScaler (fitted_scaler.pkl), synthetic centroid.
